findings.claim: The whole-file check pattern `(^|[^\w.-])gentle-ai([^\w/-]|$)` is now the sole acceptance control. It misses a call that follows a JSON escape sequence in the raw file text, such as `"echo x\ngentle-ai y"`, because the `n` of `\n` is a word character. Since the check now claims to cover every value in the file, this false negative is not noted. It is an unlikely edge case.
